_doc: Tier policy for auto_update.py. Spec: docs/AUTO-UPDATE-AGENT-PLAN.md (Buddy approved 2026-10-27). Step 1 is a dry run: every rule here classifies, nothing applies. First matching rule wins, most restrictive first.

cumulus2.tier2_note: canary: apply, restart the affected user units, verify Qwen answers

cumulus1.tier2_note: only after cumulus2 has run Tier 2 clean for 3 days; restarts follow RUNBOOK-TUNNEL-AND-REBOOT order (open decision 1)

apple: macOS/Apple update on CIRRUS: nobody logs in, so it never installs itself; fold into the monthly reboot (open decision 2)
macOS auto-install is on for the MacBook; Apple applies it

apt._blocked_source_globs: Added 2026-10-27 from live data: xserver-xorg-video-nvidia-580 (source nvidia-graphics-drivers-580) is pending from noble-security on both servers and matches no name glob, so it would have landed in Tier 1 and split the 580 driver stack.

tier2_sources.glibc: glibc: every running process maps it
tier2_sources.openssl: openssl: every TLS client and server links it

snap: snapd auto-refresh applies it, timed into the window; this agent never runs snap (Firefox/Thunderbird/Snap Store: open decision 3)

external.cloudflared: cloudflared_update.py owns it (S515); this agent only reports it

deny.tailscale: T68: brew upgrade orphans its daemon
deny.ollama: model runtime: runner cirrus-ollama-upgrade / re-qualification, never a blind brew upgrade
deny.llama.cpp: local-model stack: verified models need re-qualification (docs/LOCAL-MODEL-IMPROVEMENT.md)
deny.mlx: local-model stack: verified models need re-qualification (docs/LOCAL-MODEL-IMPROVEMENT.md)
deny.mlx-c: local-model stack: verified models need re-qualification (docs/LOCAL-MODEL-IMPROVEMENT.md)
